title: Expected Impact of Recent Announcement of Increase in Pricing Cap for School Bus Fares
what_it_is: Expected Impact of Recent Announcement of Increase in Pricing Cap for School Bus Fares

sections.label: School bus fare cap increase
sections.summary: MOE allows school bus operators to raise fare caps for mainstream schools by up to 13% from 1 January 2024, and notes subsidy increases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) is, thus, allowing school bus operators to increase the pricing cap of school bus fares for mainstream schools under existing contracts by up to 13%, with effect from 1 January 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In January 2023, school bus subsidy under the MOE Financial Assistance Scheme was raised from 60% of monthly school bus fares to 65%, to take into account rising school bus fares.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For special education (SPED) schools, eligible students taking school bus services can apply for the Enabling Transport Subsidy administered by SG Enable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The subsidy was increased from 1 July 2022 to help defray the cost of school bus fares.

sections.label: Student reliance and operator exits
sections.summary: Some students have little choice but to use school bus services, and some operators have exited due to manpower shortages and business cost increases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Some students, especially those in primary school and those throughout the school years in SPED schools, have little choice but to use the school bus services, and some bus operators, due to manpower shortages and business cost increases, have already exited the industry.

sections.label: MOE talks with bus associations
sections.summary: MOE has discussed operating models and business challenges with school bus associations and will continue working with operators to meet schools' needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE has also been in discussions with the school bus associations to better understand their operating models as well as their business challenges.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Some of the measures that we have introduced in recent months will take time for the school bus sector to stabilise and consolidate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We will continue to work closely with the bus operators, so that there will be sufficient operators available to meet the needs of our schools.
